'''Endor Draft''' is a Star Wars CCG booster-draft format in which each player drafts from 6 [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] packs. [[Decipher]] published it in the Endor Rules Supplement in 1999 as "an exciting new tournament format" that "can be run as a Decipher sanctioned sealed deck tournament".<ref name="endorrules">[http://www1.decipher.com/starwars/rules/endorrules.html Star Wars CCG – Endor Rules Supplement], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990915001027/http://www1.decipher.com/starwars/rules/endorrules.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' 6 unopened Endor packs per player; 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' 1999 –
* '''Also called:''' Endor Draft Tournament (Decipher)
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's rules:<ref name="endorrules" />
* "The standalone nature of the Endor expansion allows players to take part in an exciting new tournament format." It needs a sanctioned tournament director and at least 8 players.
* "An Endor Draft tournament is run using standard Decipher sealed deck rules, but with one major difference: instead of trading cards with one opponent as in standard sealed deck tournaments, players choose cards from a much larger pool when constructing their 40-card decks."
* Each player (and the director, if needed to make the numbers even) provides 6 unopened Endor packs. Sides are assigned at random with equal numbers of Light and Dark.
* Groups of 6 where possible, otherwise 4 (never more than two groups of 4), with Light and Dark players alternating around the table.
* 45 seconds for the first pick from a pack, 30 seconds for each later pick. A player takes a card of their own side, except that "a foil card may be selected regardless of allegiance." A player passed a pack with no card of their side passes it on without picking. Packs pass right, then left, alternating for all six packs.
* "After all of the players have completed the draft, the tournament reverts to the standard Decipher sealed deck format, with two exceptions": 15 minutes of deck building, and a player with fewer than 40 cards of their side plays with as close to 40 as possible. Results are submitted by the standard sealed deck method.

== History ==
Decipher's Endor Rules Supplement page with these rules was online by September 1999.<ref name="endorrules" />

In 2000 Decipher's [[Death Star II Booster Draft]] drafted 3 Endor and 3 Death Star II boosters instead.<ref name="ds2ce-rules">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/deathstar2/rules.html Death Star II Closed Environment Tournaments Rules], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011004150405/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/deathstar2/rules.html Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee's Alternate Format Tournament Guide reprints the Endor Draft rules "from Decipher's Rules Supplement for the Endor Expansion".<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
